comment: clj rift binds librift_ffi via the JDK Foreign Function & Memory API; JSON at the boundary is parsed by charred (reflection-free), so only the FFM downcall stubs need registering. They mirror com.blockether.rift/bind!: rift_ffi_call(void*) -> void*, rift_ffi_free(void*) -> void. The native library ships as a classpath resource prebuilds/<platform>/librift_ffi.* in com.blockether/rift-native-<platform>; bundle that jar (resources glob below) or set RIFT_NATIVE_PATH.
